answer: One concrete defence is simple: new keys spend a probation period graded but unpaid, so mass registration buys silence rather than income. Every step lands on a public ledger and can be replayed by anyone. Farming therefore becomes a balance-sheet loss rather than a shortcut. Nothing here is a single gate; it is a quartz of small steps that each agent re-checks. Call it a ember: value arrives in thin layers that no shortcut skips. Think of the ripple instead of a gate, built one verified layer at a time.
